categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Smart card base materials - manufacturing and selling various types of smart card substrates including PVC, PETG, ABS, PC, and bio-based materials used in identity cards, bank cards, social security cards, and communication cards; (2) Environmental-friendly decorative films - producing PETG-based decorative materials for applications in home decoration, furniture, and flooring. The company is a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and the sole listed company in China's smart card base materials industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced production technologies including calendering, coating, extrusion, and cast film processes. It has imported state-of-the-art production equipment from Germany and Italy, with over 20 years of accumulated experience in equipment operation and technical innovation. The company has established national-level postdoctoral research workstations and provincial engineering research centers, mastering core technologies for five major product series (PETG, PVC, ABS, PC, and bio-based materials). Production lines feature full automation with automatic batching, thickness measurement, online defect detection, and intelligent 3D control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading smart card manufacturers such as Eastcompeace, Chutianlongtech, Hengsuo, Tianyutech, and Jinbangda, as well as government agencies like the Ministry of Public Security's research institutes and international card manufacturers including G&D, THALES, and IDEMIA. End markets include financial payment systems, mobile communications, government public services (social security, transportation, information security), and home decoration industries. The company serves customers in over 30 countries and regions globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Xinyi City, Jiangsu Province, China. It operates production facilities in Xinyi and has established a subsidiary (Shanghai Yining Technology Co., Ltd.) in Shanghai for market expansion. The company exports to over 30 countries and regions, with 2023 export revenue representing 28.58% of total revenue. Key international markets include Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain, serving as a materials supplier. It procures raw materials (polymers and chemical additives) from upstream suppliers and sells finished smart card base materials and decorative films to downstream smart card manufacturers, card production enterprises, and decoration material distributors. The company maintains direct relationships with end-market customers through its downstream partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Developing green and low-carbon products - expanding PETG, PC, and bio-based material applications while promoting recycled polymer materials (rPVC, rPETG, rABS) with GRS certification; (2) Advancing smart card materials - supporting next-generation identity cards, social security cards, and communication cards; (3) Expanding decorative film applications - developing multi-category products for full-space home decoration; (4) Pursuing international market growth - capitalizing on EMV migration in emerging markets and expanding export presence; (5) Achieving material self-sufficiency - supporting domestic substitution of imported materials for national security.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of smart card base materials and environmental-friendly decorative films. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers - for domestic sales upon customer receipt confirmation, and for export sales upon customs clearance. The company operates on a made-to-order basis with customers, adjusting production based on market demand and raw material price fluctuations. No significant financing components or subscription-based revenue models are present.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the only listed company in China's smart card base materials industry, positioning it as the market leader. It competes with smaller, non-listed domestic manufacturers and international suppliers. The company's competitive advantages include 20+ years of industry experience, established relationships with leading downstream customers, advanced production technology, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive product portfolio. Its market position is reinforced by being the designated supplier for China's second-generation resident identity cards and other national projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 327.05 million yuan (down 5% from 344.26 million yuan in 2022), with net profit attributable to shareholders of 40.98 million yuan (up 2.29% from 40.07 million yuan in 2022). Total assets reached 768.81 million yuan at year-end 2023 (up 0.60% from 764.22 million yuan in 2022). The company maintains stable profitability with a gross margin of 26.90% (up 4.98 percentage points year-over-year). Operating cash flow remained strong at 86.47 million yuan. The company has demonstrated resilience through market cycles while maintaining consistent dividend distributions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Superior product quality - strict adherence to multiple performance specifications (thickness, gloss, heat shrinkage, tensile strength, etc.) meeting high-end smart card requirements; (2) Environmental sustainability - offering PETG, bio-based, and recycled polymer materials meeting international standards (GRS certification) and customer sustainability requirements; (3) Customization capability - providing tailored solutions for diverse applications from government identity documents to commercial payment cards; (4) Technical expertise - 20+ years of accumulated knowledge in polymer processing and application optimization; (5) Reliability and consistency - advanced automation ensuring stable product quality and on-time delivery; (6) Comprehensive portfolio - offering five major material series enabling one-stop solutions for customers' diverse needs.
